businesses.business: enterprise mobile computing, barcode scanning and printing technology

offering_description.value: Designs and sells rugged mobile computers, barcode scanners, printers, RFID readers, machine vision and related software to enterprises. Customers use them to track, manage and automate inventory, assets and workflows. Products are made through contract manufacturers and sold mainly through channel partners, with software and support services.

primary_products.value: mobile computers; barcode scanners; barcode, label and card printers; RFID readers and tags; machine vision and fixed industrial scanners

primary_services.value: repair and maintenance support; managed device services; software subscriptions for workflow and asset visibility; professional services

customer_segment.value: B2B: retailers, warehouses and logistics firms, manufacturers, healthcare providers, hospitality and banks; B2G: government and public sector agencies

end_markets.value: retail and e-commerce; transportation and logistics; manufacturing; healthcare; hospitality; public sector

revenue_model.value: product sales: hardware devices, printers, scanners and supplies; service fees: maintenance, repair and support contracts; subscription: cloud software and analytics subscriptions

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets devices built by contract manufacturers, sold to enterprises via partners; software / platform: workflow, device management and asset visibility software for enterprise customers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: mobile computing, scanning, printing, RFID, machine vision and software for enterprise data capture

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: value-added resellers, system integrators and independent software vendors; distributors / dealers: technology distributors serving resellers; direct sales: large enterprise accounts; online: web store for printers and supplies
distribution_channels.category: partners / resellers; distributors / dealers; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety, radio emissions, export controls, trade tariffs and environmental rules, FCC and CE compliance
